title: Finite adic compactification and section comparison data
statement: For a finite-field datum k and a prime ell distinct from its characteristic, define the finite adic compactification-section comparison data, without asserting their existence. For every separated finite-type k-scheme W and finite extension E/Q_ell, the data consist of the continuous realization J fixed on integral representatives by coefficient transport and derived tensor, its fully faithful E-linear heart realization, the actual coefficient unit, and a natural E-linear identification of the recorded ordinary H^0 with continuous module sections and Hom from the unit, normalized by evaluation at 1. For every quasi-compact open immersion j:U->T over k, include an additive functor preserving finite limits and finite colimits, its identification with the actual compact-support action using (j,id_T), completed pullback, their adjunction with invertible open unit, and its realization as sheafified extension of the continuous module presheaf through the actual open slice. Normalize the slice ring map by equality of continuous coefficient values and the pullback of the unit by 1->1. Include natural ordinary-section restriction with the Hom restriction formula, natural inside adic fibre comparisons, and zero outside fibres. For proper T include the actual compact H_c^0 objects, natural linear Hom identifications and compactification H_c^0(U,F)=H^0(T,j!F), with the compact-to-ordinary map given by restriction and the inverse open unit. For every finite coefficient embedding include its actual completed scalar-extension functor on hearts, continuous sheaf tensor comparison, tensor-unit-normalized ordinary cohomology and Hom comparisons, open extension/restriction comparisons preserving adjunction and coefficient units, and compatible compact comparisons on 1 tensor x. All data are simultaneous over schemes and fields, including identity embeddings. These are comparison diagrams, not additional hypotheses on the sheaf. Use the finite-field datum, coefficient rings, schemes, actual cohomology, hearts, compact-support action, continuous realization and fibres, and common coefficient conventions from [def-weil-finite-field-fiber] [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension] [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties] [def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology] [def-weil-constructible-heart] [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support] [lem-per-continuous-rational-derived-realization] [lem-per-adic-heart-pullback-fibres] [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients] [lem-sf-field-stage-ordinary-realization] [lem-cbc-completed-extension-zero-comparison] [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-ringed-open-closed]. The normalized point-section and ordinary-image models are [def-a1-adic-section-canonical-models]. For every heart object the ordinary Hom equivalence is pinned by: the actual ordinary_obj H0 identity, point.hom on rationalImage, point.J and the normalized image comparison, the inverse homEquiv of the actual direct_image derived adjunction, and the normalized pullback of the coefficient unit. Use the actual derived adjunction of [lem-a1-rational-direct-image-realization]. The image comparison is fixed on integral representatives by the actual coefficient transport, the actual Roos projection comparisons, and the canonical localization projection. The proper compactification comparison starts from rationalCompactSections at the literal compactification (T,j,b); its integral comparison is fixed by equality of the finite projection adjuncts, including the finite identity pushforward at (j,id_T). Its H0 map fixes compactification, hence fixes the compact Hom map through ordinary_hom. Define the derived compact-to-ordinary arrow independently as Rb_* of the adjoint transpose of the realized inverse open unit, followed by the direct-image compositor and the structure-map equality. Require comparison to realize this arrow; its Hom restriction formula is a separate equality. Require scalar change and the common finite-stage comparisons to preserve these Hom, compactification and comparison maps on every 1 tensor x. Its finite realization, image normalization, ordinary, open and proper components are respectively [def-a1-finite-adic-section-realization-core], [def-a1-finite-adic-image-normalization], [def-a1-finite-adic-ordinary-section-data], [def-a1-finite-adic-open-section-data], [def-a1-finite-adic-proper-section-data].
